transcript_previews.content: Use 1 ETH total from Alice to add liquidity to the Uniswap V2 ETH/USDC pool on Ethereum. Swap half of the ETH to USDC first, then approve USDC if needed and add the ETH and USDC sides as Uniswap V2 liquidity.
I’ll check Alice’s Ethereum context, resolve the Uniswap V2 contracts/tokens, then build the swap + liquidity transactions as one verified sequence.
I’ll check Alice’s ETH balance, current network state, and the Uniswap V2 router/token details before building the full swap + liquidity batch.
I’m checking the ETH→USDC quote and current USDC approval so I can build the swap, exact approval, and liquidity add as one verified sequence.

transcript_previews.tool_topic: Simulate complete swap then liquidity add workflow

transcript_previews.content: The full workflow simulated, but the liquidity add failed because the post-swap pool ratio requires less USDC than the swap output; my token-side minimum was too tight. I’m checking the pool reserves now and will restage only the liquidity parameters that need fixing.

The full batch failed at the liquidity step because the post-swap pool ratio made the 0.5 ETH side slightly too high relative to the USDC received. I’m tightening the workflow by keeping the 0.5 ETH swap and exact USDC approval, but lowering only the ETH-side minimum so the router can use the matching amount of ETH and refund any tiny excess.

transcript_previews.content:
Ready for wallet approval.

- Swap 0.5 ETH → USDC on Uniswap V2, minimum 987.050045 USDC
- Approve exactly 987.050045 USDC to the Uniswap V2 Router
- Add ETH/USDC liquidity to Alice, using the USDC received and matching ETH; unused ETH is refunded

Simulation passed for tx-4, tx-5, tx-6. Please approve the wallet prompt to submit.
